summary: This file is a pure configuration module (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dataset settings for MMDetection using the PASCAL VOC 2007+2012 dataset.
config_variables: img_norm_cfg — image normalization parameters (mean, std, to_rgb)
train_pipeline — list of preprocessing transforms for training (LoadImageFromFile, LoadAnnotations, Resize, RandomFlip, Normalize, Pad, DefaultFormatBundle, Collect)
test_pipeline — list of preprocessing transforms for testing (LoadImageFromFile, MultiScaleFlipAug with Resize, RandomFlip, Normalize, Pad, ImageToTensor, Collect)
data — dict with samples_per_gpu, workers_per_gpu, train/val/test dataset configs using RepeatDataset (3x) for training and VOC2007 test split for val/test
evaluation — dict with interval=1 and metric='mAP'
use_cases: Configure MMDetection training on PASCAL VOC 2007+2012 combined dataset
Set up image normalization with ImageNet-style mean/std values
Define training data augmentation pipeline with resize, flip, and padding
Define test-time augmentation pipeline with MultiScaleFlipAug
Configure evaluation to compute mAP every training interval
note: No callable functions, classes, or APIs exist in this file. It is a configuration-only module intended to be imported by MMDetection's config system.
